verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a Fastmail export feature, such as downloading mail, contacts or calendars as files in open formats. What it does document is JMAP as an open, standards-based API with no lock-in, IMAP access mentioned in passing by community members, and an import tool for moving mail into Fastmail. An open protocol is a building block a developer could use to construct an export, and import is the opposite direction, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
